latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Murder Drones OC Maker skill.
- Transforms a person into a Murder Drones-inspired robotic drone character using AI.
- Supports input of an optional reference image and custom text description.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WeShop API key for use.
- Provides endpoints to run, poll, and upload images to the WeShop OpenAPI platform.
- Emphasizes security by ensuring API keys are only used with the official openapi.weshop.ai domain.
